title: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term
question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.

WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
  HAVING MIN(term_start) >= '1917-01-01' AND MIN(term_start) <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, first_start
  FROM first_terms
),
periods AS (
  SELECT 1 AS p UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cohort
)
SELECT p.p AS period,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
             WHEN t.term_start <= date(c.first_start, '+' || p.p || ' years', '-1 day')
              AND (t.term_end IS NULL OR t.term_end >= date(c.first_start, '+' || p.p || ' years', '-1 day'))
             THEN c.id_bioguide END) * 1.0 / cs.n, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN cohort c
LEFT JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
GROUP BY p.p, cs.n
ORDER BY p.p

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
  HAVING MIN(term_start) >= '1917-01-01' AND MIN(term_start) <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT f.id_bioguide, f.first_start
  FROM first_terms f
),
periods AS (
  SELECT 1 AS p UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
)
SELECT p.p AS period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide) AS cohort_size,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.term_start <= date(c.first_start, '+' || p.p || ' years')
                           AND t.term_end >= date(c.first_start, '+' || p.p || ' years')
                          THEN c.id_bioguide END) AS retained,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.term_start <= date(c.first_start, '+' || p.p || ' years')
                                 AND t.term_end >= date(c.first_start, '+' || p.p || ' years')
                                THEN c.id_bioguide END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide), 4) AS retention_rate
FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN cohort c
LEFT JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
GROUP BY p.p
ORDER BY p.p

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_start
  FROM legislators_terms
  WHERE term_number = 0
    AND term_start >= '1917-01-01'
    AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
years AS (
  SELECT 1 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort_size AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cohort),
retained AS (
  SELECT y.y,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide) AS retained
  FROM years y
  CROSS JOIN cohort c
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t
    WHERE t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
      AND t.term_start <= strftime('%Y', c.first_start) || '-' || printf('%02d', y) || '-31'
      AND (t.term_end IS NULL OR t.term_end >= strftime('%Y', c.first_start) || '-' || printf('%02d', y) || '-31')
  )
  GROUP BY y.y
)
SELECT r.y AS year_offset,
       ROUND(1.0 * r.retained / cs.n, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM retained r
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
ORDER BY r.y;
